segments.name: Investment Management Segment
segments.description: Originates and invests in secured term loans, mezzanine debt and CLO fund securities in privately-held middle market companies, generating current income and capital appreciation.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280: Segment Reporting ("ASC 280"), the Company has determined that it has a single operating and reporting segment, the "Investment Management Segment".

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay the company interest on its debt investments in middle market companies, so it earns current income and capital appreciation.
revenueModel.evidence: In our Debt Securities Portfolio, our investment objective is to generate current income and, to a lesser extent, capital appreciation from the investments in senior secured term loans, mezzanine debt and selected equity investments in privately-held middle market companies.
